payload.claim: Recent energy-price rises plausibly explain much of headline inflation acceleration, but UK core/services acceleration could signal broader persistence. One monthly release insufficient for a causal claim.
payload.falsification: At the next two UK ONS CPI releases (2026-11-18 and December scheduled publication) check whether core and services 12-month rates keep rising. A return toward September-minus-0.2pp in core/services weakens broad pass-through account; oil reversal may separately weaken headline.
payload.next_test: No statistical link to financial asset returns asserted; distinguish energy base effects from underlying inflation.

evidence.claim: UK September CPI 3.5% y/y versus August 3.1%; core 2.8% versus 2.6%; services 3.7% versus 3.4%.
US September 2026 CPI +0.6% m/m and +3.7% y/y; gasoline +9.1% m/m.
